validation.original_audit: CPL3 INVD/WBINVD now attempt vector 13 delivery at unchanged RIP=0x6000. The supplied fixture has no IDT, so delivery ends in a triple fault. The native REX2 sequence now requires exactly three slices, including two cache-operation exits.
Atomic callback RAM-image fixtures were corrected in a separate semantic commit to account for architectural paging A/D writes.
